answer: An answer is only accepted from an identity that has already had 7 attestations accepted by others, which means the first thing a new alias must do is earn trust rather than claim reward. The vertex counter is kept in harbor and signal shows each threshold crossing. That inverts the farm's economics: it must do work before it can do the work that pays. That bill is paid per identity, so 292 aliases cost 96 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
